learning_objective: 🎯 Dive into the exciting team sport of Volleyball and learn how to serve, bump, set, and smash the ball over the net like a champion!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every thrilling rally begins with a serve! You can use an underhand serve for simple control or an overhand serve to send the ball flying fast and hard over the net to the opponent's side.

When the ball comes zooming toward you, you use your forearms to pop it back up safely. By locking your fingers and keeping your arms straight, you create a perfect platform for the ball to bounce off!
A set is like giving a perfect gift to your teammate! You use your fingertips above your head to gently push the ball high into the air, making it super easy for the next player to hit.
This is the ultimate attacking move! A spike involves jumping high into the air and smacking the ball down hard onto the opponent's court so fast that they cannot catch or return it.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Balloon Volley Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Blow up a balloon and try to keep it in the air for as long as possible using only the proper bumping and setting hand positions. Don't let it touch the ground!

quick_recap: ⭐ Volleyball is an amazing team sport that builds your jumping power, hand-eye coordination, and quick reflexes.
⭐ A perfect volleyball play uses three steps: Pass (receive the ball), Set (prepare the attack), and Spike (smash it over the net)!
